crossRefs.note: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler…
Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!
Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for…
Behold, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.
Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that…
If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove…
I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way…

translations.web: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.
translations.bsb: No nobles will be left to proclaim a king, and all her princes will come to nothing.
translations.kjv: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
translations.asv: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.
